$extensions.aesthetic: open, optimistic connectivity — light-filled social spaces that feel effortless and human

surface.$description: Primary background — pure white canvas, the air through which content breathes

surface-subtle.$description: Secondary background — Facebook gray, used for page-level fill behind cards

surface-card.$description: Card and post surface — white, the dominant container color across all Meta products

surface-hover.$description: Hover state for interactive surfaces — subtle cool-neutral lift

surface-active.$description: Active/pressed state background — visible depression feedback

surface-overlay.$description: Modal/dialog backdrop overlay — standard Meta dimming

surface-blue-tint.$description: Selected/active state tint — lightest Meta Blue for active nav items, selected states

accent.$description: Meta Blue primary — the defining brand color, used for CTAs, links, and key interactive elements

accent-hover.$description: Meta Blue hover — slightly deeper for hover feedback on blue elements

accent-active.$description: Meta Blue active/pressed — deepest blue for pressed state

accent-light.$description: Meta Light Blue — secondary blue for highlights, badges, and lighter UI accents

accent-secondary.$description: Green accent — online indicators, positive actions, Messenger/WhatsApp crossover

text-primary.$description: Primary text — near-black, slightly warmer than pure #000, used for names and headlines

text-secondary.$description: Secondary text — cool medium gray for timestamps, captions, metadata

text-tertiary.$description: Tertiary text — placeholder text, disabled labels, de-emphasized content

text-link.$description: Link text — Meta Blue, consistent with accent for all text links

text-on-accent.$description: Text on blue buttons and surfaces — always pure white

text-on-dark.$description: Primary text on dark surfaces — light gray for dark mode readability

error.$description: Error/danger — Facebook red, used for notifications, errors, and destructive actions

error-bg.$description: Error background tint — soft red wash for error containers

success.$description: Success — Facebook green, online status, confirmations, positive actions

success-bg.$description: Success background tint — soft green wash for success containers

warning.$description: Warning — amber, used for caution states and attention signals

warning-bg.$description: Warning background tint — soft amber wash for warning containers

notification.$description: Notification badge — same red as error, the unmistakable Facebook notification dot

focus.$description: Focus ring — Meta Blue outline for keyboard accessibility

border.$description: Default border — light cool gray, the standard card/input separator

border-subtle.$description: Subtle border — lighter than default, used for inner dividers within cards

border-strong.$description: Strong border — more visible for emphasized containers and input focus

border-dark.$description: Dark mode border — for containers on dark backgrounds

dark-surface.$description: Dark mode page background — Facebook dark mode near-black

dark-surface-card.$description: Dark mode card surface — elevated dark container

dark-surface-hover.$description: Dark mode hover — visible hover state on dark surfaces

reaction-like.$description: Like reaction — Meta Blue thumbs up

reaction-wow.$description: Wow reaction — bright yellow (shared with haha)

font-display.$value: Optimistic Display, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-display.$description: Display/headline font — Meta's custom Optimistic typeface for large headings and marketing

font-body.$value: Optimistic Text, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-body.$description: Body/UI font — Optimistic Text for body copy, buttons, labels, and all interface text

font-system.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font-system.$description: System fallback stack — used in product UI when Optimistic is unavailable

font-mono.$value: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Courier New, monospace
font-mono.$description: Monospace — for code blocks, developer tools, and technical content

scale-display.$description: Display — hero headlines and marketing headlines — 3rem

scale-body-lg.$description: Body large — post body text, expanded content — 1.0625rem

scale-base.$description: Base — standard body and UI text — 0.9375rem (Facebook's actual base)

scale-small.$description: Small — badges, notification counts, fine print — 0.75rem

scale-micro.$description: Micro — reaction counts inline, minimal labels — 0.625rem

line-height-normal.$description: Normal — Facebook's standard body line-height, tighter than most to maximize feed density

line-height-relaxed.$description: Relaxed — long-form content, marketing pages, reading experiences

weight-medium.$description: Medium — nav items, secondary labels, emphasis within text

weight-semibold.$description: Semibold — section headings, card titles, button text

weight-bold.$description: Bold — display headlines, user names in feed, strong emphasis

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Tight — display headlines for visual density

letter-spacing-normal.$description: Normal — body and UI text, no adjustment

letter-spacing-wide.$description: Wide — overline labels, uppercase text, small badges

unit.$description: Base unit — Meta uses a 4px grid for sub-component spacing

2xs.$description: Micro spacing — inline element gaps, reaction margins

xs.$description: Extra small — icon-to-text gaps, badge padding

sm.$description: Small — inner card padding, compact control spacing

md.$description: Medium — standard card padding, list item spacing

lg.$description: Large — section inner padding, generous card padding

xl.$description: Extra large — feed card side padding, column gaps

2xl.$description: Double extra large — section vertical padding, card stacking gap

3xl.$description: Section gap — vertical space between major feed sections

section-gap.$description: Page section gap — space between marketing page sections

page-margin-desktop.$description: Page margin desktop — horizontal padding on marketing pages

page-margin-mobile.$description: Page margin mobile — horizontal padding on mobile

container-max.$description: Max container width — Facebook feed column max-width

container-wide.$description: Wide container — marketing pages, full-width layouts

feed-width.$description: Feed column width — the sacred News Feed single-column width

radius-xs.$description: Extra small — inline tags, tiny badges

radius-standard.$description: Standard — cards, inputs, buttons, the workhorse radius across Meta products

radius-xl.$description: Extra large — Messenger bubbles, large interactive cards

radius-pill.$description: Pill — reaction pills, search bars, chip filters, the signature Meta shape

radius-circle.$description: Circle — profile avatars, story rings, online indicators

level-0.$description: Flat — no shadow, inline content within cards

level-1.$description: Subtle — standard card shadow, feed posts on gray background

button-primary.$description: Button primary — subtle outer shadow + inset highlight for 3D feel

easing-default.$description: Ease — standard CSS ease, Meta's default for most transitions

easing-enter.$description: Enter — decelerate into position, used for modals and dropdowns appearing

easing-exit.$description: Exit — accelerate out, used for closing overlays and dismissals

easing-spring.$description: Spring — bouncy overshoot, used for reaction animations and Like button press

reduced-duration.$description: Near-zero duration for prefers-reduced-motion. Applied via media query.

reduced-easing.$description: Linear easing for reduced motion -- no spring/bounce.

mobile.$description: Mobile — single column feed, stacked layout

tablet.$description: Tablet — sidebar appears, two-column navigation begins

desktop.$description: Desktop — three-column layout (nav + feed + contacts sidebar)

desktop-wide.$description: Desktop wide — full layout with generous margins
